_comment: Category min-duration availability feasibility check added 2026-09-26 (docs/category-min-duration-availability-design.md §8, feel & heal pilot). Covers: the check fires only when a category-availability question arrives BEFORE any tier/add-on/duration is stated; a fully-specified booking in the same breath skips it entirely; found=false declines gracefully without continuing to narrow; found=true continues into the normal narrowing questions.

scenarios.name: Category + availability question, nothing else stated — check fires before any narrowing

history.content: Does anyone have space for a remedial massage today?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks exactly one filler phrase (e.g. 'One moment.') then calls universal_router intent='category_availability_check' with payload service_category='remedial_massage', with zero other questions asked first (no add-on question, no tier question, no duration question). FAIL if agent asks about add-ons/tier/duration before checking, or calls confirm_service directly, or calls any tool other than universal_router.

scenarios.name: Category named WITH tier/duration already stated — skip the check entirely, narrow normally

history.content: I'd like a remedial massage with Gene, 60 minutes.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent does NOT call category_availability_check at all (the caller has already fully specified tier via naming Gene and duration via '60 minutes', so this is a normal booking, not a feasibility question) — agent should proceed toward confirm_service (may ask about add-ons first, per the ADD-ON QUESTION rule, since that wasn't stated). FAIL if agent calls universal_router intent='category_availability_check'.

scenarios.name: Feasibility check returns found=false — decline gracefully, never continue narrowing

history.content: Do you have anything for a relaxation massage this week?

{"status": "success", "intent": "category_availability_check", "uni_router_intent": "category_availability_checked", "found": "false", "category_resolved": "Relaxation or Classic Massage", "category_min_duration_minutes": "45", "exact_appointment_type_pending": "", "message": "Nothing available for that this week, I'm afraid."}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent tells the caller plainly that nothing is available (using or closely matching the tool's message) and then offers to pass a message to the clinic for follow-up. FAIL if agent asks about tier, add-ons, or duration for Relaxation/Classic Massage after being told there's no room, or if agent claims availability exists.

scenarios.name: Feasibility check returns found=true — acknowledge briefly, then continue normal narrowing

history.content: Does anyone have room for a remedial massage today?

{"status": "success", "intent": "category_availability_check", "uni_router_intent": "category_availability_checked", "found": "true", "category_resolved": "Remedial Massage", "category_min_duration_minutes": "45", "exact_appointment_type_pending": "true", "message": "Yes, there's room for that today."}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent briefly acknowledges availability (something like 'Good news, we do have room today') and then asks the ADD-ON QUESTION ('Would you like Dry Needling, Cupping, or a Salt Scrub added to that, or just the massage on its own?') since no add-on/tier/duration has been stated yet. FAIL if agent calls confirm_service directly without asking the still-unresolved add-on question, or re-runs category_availability_check again this turn.
